# Native tour formatter fixtures

These 27 unchanged sources were evaluated from `nativeExamples` in
`dekaruntime/website` main on 3 October 2026, tree `5200d07509a3337641642bd4ebfce0a88d0c95d8`:

- `lib/deka-native/example.ts`
- `lib/deka-native/beginner-examples.ts`

The standalone sources exercise the formatter; they do not depend on browser
HTML/CSS or the website build. `native_roundtrip.rs` and the explicit-root audit
require parser roundtrips and byte-identical second passes. Changes to the
current tour can refresh this snapshot without changing the formatter contract.
